references.text: Hebron is mentioned as the place where Anak's children lived when the spies explored the land.
Moses promised that Caleb would receive the land he had traveled through because of his faithfulness to the Lord.
Moses gives Caleb the promise of an inheritance as a reward for his loyalty.
Caleb reminds Joshua of Moses' promise and asks for Hebron as his inheritance, and he drives out Anak's three sons.
Joshua gave Hebron to Caleb as an inheritance, and Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
Hebron was given to the descendants of Aaron, but the fields and villages belonged to Caleb.
The Anakites are described as giants whom the Israelites feared when they explored the land.
